note.zh-TW: 教材以一年為界；IAS 1.66 另含正常營業週期。同一張名詞卡也用於「流動資產合計」列。
note.en: The course uses one year as the boundary; IAS 1.66 also allows the normal operating cycle. The same card serves the total current assets line.

definition.zh-TW: 預期在一年內會變成現金或用掉的資產，例如現金、應收帳款與存貨。模板的分組標題，也是流動比率的分子。
definition.en: Assets expected to be turned into cash or used up within a year, such as cash, trade receivables and inventories. A template group heading and the numerator of the current ratio.
